newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse lifted by Unilever.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse lifted by Unilever.

text.p: Ghana Stock Exchange's All-Share Index rose slightly on Monday, boosted by gains in consumer goods manufacturer Unilever, the exchange's market report showed.
The index rose 0.43 points to 384.03 from 383.60 on Friday.

Unilever rose 10 cedis to 950 cedis. The only other movers were Paterson Zochonis, a consumer goods trading and manufacturing company, which rose one cedi to 276, and Fan Milk Limited, which fell one cedi to 384.
Bids outstripped offers by 5,389,590 to 1,125,890 with 863,000 shares changing hands -- 747,400 of them of Pioneer Tobacco Company, which ended unchanged at 300 cedis.
